# Talk Tracks: CarBot Cloud CXM

**Generated by**: /sales-enablement
**Date**: 2026-02-26

---

## GM Talk Track

### 20-Second Version
"CarBot Cloud CXM puts every call, text, email, and AI conversation across your whole operation into one screen. AI handles the follow-through — scheduling appointments, confirming them, updating your CRM. It's free for CarBot clients, and it looks like the tools your team already uses."

### 60-Second Version
"You're running 10 rooftops across three states. Right now, to know what happened with a customer, someone has to pull up the CRM, check call logs, look at texts, and maybe check an AI tool that pushed a note somewhere. CXM puts all of that in one timeline per customer. When a call ends and an appointment is set, AI schedules it, sends the confirmation, and marks the task complete — no one has to touch it. Your team uses a familiar interface — Outlook, Gmail, Apple Mail — so there's nothing new to learn. And it's included free with your CarBot services."

### 3-Minute Version
"Let me paint the picture. You acquired three stores in Cookeville. Great market — no CarMax, no Carvana. But you're in Lexington. You need visibility without being on-site, and your new staff isn't ready for a technology overhaul.

CXM connects all your locations into one dashboard. You see every live call happening right now. You see every lead and where it is in the process. You see every AI interaction and what it accomplished. From your desk. From your phone. From an Apple TV in your office.

Your Cookeville team starts with an interface that looks like Outlook. It's familiar. They're working leads the same way they always have — CXM just shows everything in one place. Behind the scenes, AI is handling the after-hours leads, the day-two follow-ups, the appointment confirmations. Tasks complete themselves. Your CRM stays updated.

As they get comfortable, you layer in more. AI coaching for the new reps. Instant lead verification so every web lead gets called in 5 seconds. Visual workflow automation so your process runs itself.

And here's the thing — CXM is free for any CarBot client. No new budget approval. No new vendor contract. Just your CarBot rep setting it up.

One of our dealer partners said it best: 'That's what we need. Just to make sure it's all in one house.' That's CXM."

## GSM Talk Track

### 20-Second Version
"CXM gives your team one place to see every lead, every call, and every follow-up — with AI that doesn't just log notes but actually schedules appointments and completes tasks. Your reps pick the interface they want, and it's free."

### 60-Second Version
"Your BDC process is only as good as the people executing it — and people miss steps. CXM fixes that. You build your follow-up process once in a visual editor: AI calls the lead in 5 seconds, sends a text on day two, emails on day three, follows up on day five. AI handles the routine. Your team handles the closeable ups.

When a call ends and the customer sets an appointment, nobody does anything. The system schedules it, confirms it, and marks the task complete. Every night it reviews every open opportunity — did something get missed? And your team can use the interface they want: Discord, a social feed, TikTok-style. Same data, their way."

### 3-Minute Version
"Let me show you what this looks like in practice. A lead comes in from your website at 9:15pm. Within 5 seconds, AI calls the customer. It knows their name, it knows the vehicle they inquired about. The customer confirms interest. AI soft-sets a showroom visit for tomorrow at 2pm.

The appointment appears in your CRM automatically. A confirmation text goes out. A reminder email follows in the morning. When the customer shows up tomorrow, your salesperson already has the full conversation transcript — they know what was discussed, what the customer is looking for, and what objections came up.

That's the AI watcher. It doesn't just talk to the customer — it follows through on everything that conversation started.

Now, your 23-year-old BDC rep? She doesn't want to look at Outlook all day. She sees CXM in a Discord-style layout — conversations on the left, details on the right, notifications in real time. Your desk manager? He gets the classic view. Same data. Everyone's happy.

Your team can also practice with AI customers through CarBot Coach — 80% of users train at least monthly. Real role-play on the phone, scored and tracked.

All of this is free with your CarBot services. The question isn't whether your team needs this. It's whether you can afford to have leads coming in at night with nobody following through."

## IT Talk Track

### 20-Second Version
"CXM integrates with your CRM via API — calls logged as calls, tasks pushed back on completion. 10DLC, CNAM, STIR/SHAKEN standard. PII redaction on all transcripts. SSO supported. The architecture was built for HIPAA."

### 60-Second Version
"CXM is an API-integrated overlay on your existing CRM — VIN Solutions, eLead, or DriveCentric. It doesn't replace your system of record. It reads customer and lead data, and writes back: calls logged as calls, appointments created, tasks completed. Texts currently log as notes in VIN because VIN hasn't opened their messaging API, but that's a VIN limitation, not ours.

Telephony is fully integrated. All outbound numbers carry 10DLC registration, CNAM, and STIR/SHAKEN verification. For premium deliverability, TNS branded verification is available upstream through the carriers. Every call transcript gets processed through Assembly AI with context-aware PII redaction. SSO is supported for enterprise deployment."

## Discovery Questions

### Opening Questions
1. "How many systems does your team switch between to work a single lead?"
2. "When a lead comes in at 9pm, what happens?"
3. "How do you currently see what's happening across all your locations in real time?"

### Pain Questions
4. "What falls through the cracks most often — first response, follow-up, or appointment confirmation?"
5. "How many of your AI tools push notes versus actually completing tasks?"
6. "What happens to your process when your best BDC rep calls in sick?"

### Impact Questions
7. "If every lead got contacted in 5 seconds and every appointment got confirmed automatically, what would that be worth?"
8. "How much time does your team spend on admin tasks that could be handled by AI?"
9. "What would it mean for your operation if you could see every call, every text, every lead in one place?"

### Decision Questions
10. "Who else needs to be involved in evaluating this?"
11. "What's your timeline for making a decision on dealer technology this year?"
12. "Is there a CRM contract renewal coming up that we should be aware of?"

### Fast Disqualifiers
- "Do you currently use any CarBot services?" (CXM is free only for existing clients)
- "Is your IT team open to API integrations with your CRM?" (Required for CXM)
- "Are you in the middle of a CRM migration?" (Wait until stabilized)
